{{Top}}
[[File:Christophsis_barracks.png|thumb|right|300px|The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] barracks at the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Christophsis Republic base]]]]
A '''barracks''', also known as a '''troop center''', was a building used by various factions throughout [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]] to recruit and train [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]]. Variations of this building could be a training ground, a wide place providing enough space for infantry to train. Barracks were also where [[Troop/Legends|troops]] stationed at a base maintained bunks and living quarters. The facilities were used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==History==
Before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Delvin Constructs/Legends|Delvin Constructs]] produced two models of barracks; the [[Model MilBar C-427]], used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the [[MilBar F-221/Legends|MilBar F-221]], used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. During the same period, the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] used the mercenary barracks.
